<?php
class Invoke189 { private const VALUE = 'ok'; public function __invoke() { return fn() => new class(self::VALUE, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public string $value, public string $method) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
$owner = new Invoke189; $factory = $owner(); unset($owner); echo 'MADE;'; $child = $factory(); unset($factory); echo 'HELD;', $child->value, ':', $child->method, ';'; unset($child); echo 'DONE;';

<?php
$owner = new class { public string $tag = 'OLD'; public function __get($name) { global $owner; $owner = null; echo 'GET;'; return new class($name, $this->tag, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public string $name, public string $tag, public string $method) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } };
$child = $owner->missing; $after = new class {}; echo 'HELD;', $child->name, ':', $child->tag, ':', $child->method, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';'; unset($child); echo 'DONE;';

<?php
$owner = new class { public function __toString(): string { $child = new class {}; echo 'BODY;'; return $child::class; } };
echo 'PRE;', $owner, ';POST;'; $after = new class {}; echo $owner::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
trait StringTrait189 { public function __toString(): string { global $owner; $owner = null; $child = new class(self::VALUE) { public function __construct(public string $value) { echo 'CHILD;'; } public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP-CHILD;'; } }; echo 'TEXT;'; return $child->value; } }
class StringOwner189 { use StringTrait189; private const VALUE = 'ok'; public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
$owner = new StringOwner189; echo 'PRE;', $owner, ';POST;';

<?php
echo 'PRE;';
class BadInvoke189 { public static function __invoke() { $child = new class { final private function hidden() {} }; return $child; } }

<?php
echo 'PRE;';
class BadString189 { public function __toString(): int { $child = new class { final private function hidden() {} }; return 1; } }
